svg.text: Paata — direct wiring, seen from the back (display face down)
Boards are in the orientation they take in the box, spread apart so the pads are readable. Each tag is one wire: its colour and its number in the wire list.
shaft points down, through the front of the case
DAC: sits on the back of the display,
A pad with two tags takes two wires. Grey pads stay empty. The same number appears at both ends of a wire.
